reports.title: Malapolo ne Dikonkonona
reports.subtitle: Patula malapolo a midimu
reports.analysis_prod_good: Mu tshikondo etshi, bungi bua ditumbula bufike ku tonne {{total}}. Mudimu ewu udi usankisha bikole ne uleja kuluila kumpala kupita ngondo mushale. Mudimu udi wenda bimpe ne bintu bidi bibeba bidi bikese.
reports.analysis_prod_stable: Mu tshikondo etshi, bungi bua ditumbula bufike ku tonne {{total}}. Bungi bua ditumbula budi bushimika bimpe ne wenza bua kukumbaja bipatshila bia mudimu. Mudimu udi wenda bimpe ne bintu bidi bibeba bidi bikese.
reports.analysis_hse_safe: Mu malu a bukubi, kaba ka mudimu nkamone dituku dionso dia makenga {{incidents}}. Bidi bisankisha bikole bua kumona ne: kakuena lutatu lunene ludi lwenzeke, bidi bileja ditumikila dia mibelu ya HSE ne buimpe bua ndonguelu wetu wa bukubi.
reports.analysis_hse_danger: Mu malu a bukubi, kaba ka mudimu nkamone dituku dionso dia makenga {{incidents}}. Bidi bilomba ditangila dia lukasa bua mushindu udi makenga manene menzeke, ne bidi bilomba kukolesha bokengeli bua bukubi.
reports.analysis_finance: Dikonkonona dia bulombodi didi dileja mabanji mapatuke a dolare {{expenses}}. Dilongolola dia badje didi dilama bimpe bu mudi bilejilu bia tshitupa tshia tshidimu. Dilongeka bimpe dia mayila a bintu didi diambuluisha bua kubenga kuponya mabanji mapite.
reports.analysis_pegs: Kuyila kumpala kua Pegs kudi kuleja complétion ya {{completionRate}}%. Mpindieu, miaba {{active}} idi ishala mu mushindu wa exploration anyi ya production. Dilongolola dia miaba ya mudimu didi dilonda bimpe mukanda wa mayila kumpala wa mine.
